baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated command تُطِعْهُ at word 3 and the paired imperatives ٱسْجُدْ and ٱقْتَرِب at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line blocks pliant yielding to one addressee, then redirects body and movement: voluntary lowering becomes the route to nearness. The three commands therefore stage a transfer of allegiance rather than three detached acts.

activation_trace.role: Pliant obedience and yielding, including being under a hand or lead, supplies the human-directed control relation that is refused.
Humble bodily lowering supplies the replacement act of willing submission.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies the destination toward which the redirected body moves.

changed_reading.before: Do not comply with him; then perform prostration and come closer.
changed_reading.after: Withdraw pliancy from him and reassign it through bodily lowering to a movement of nearness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The immediate coordination of ٱسْجُدْ with ٱقْتَرِب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The body's lowest posture is juxtaposed with favored and devotional nearness. This produces a vertical paradox: access is gained through lowering rather than through self-elevation.

activation_trace.role: The forehead, prostrating limbs, and their mark make lowering concrete at the body's contact points.
Favored access and privileged nearness supply the status opened by the low posture.
Devotional approach through an offered act makes prostration a means of access, not merely a position beside it.

changed_reading.before: Prostrate and then reduce the distance.
changed_reading.after: Make the low bodily act itself the devotional means by which favored nearness opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated reading is authorized in the name of the Lord, while disclosure and the prepared writing reed locate knowledge in a creator-teacher relation. The final refusal is therefore not refusal of command as such; it protects one instructional allegiance from a rival claimant.

activation_trace.role: Obedient yielding supplies the allegiance whose proper direction is at issue.
Devotional approach supplies the positive relation preserved after the rival command is refused.
Reading and recitation supply the first authorized imperative and establish instruction as an act.
The repeated reading branch makes the instructional command persistent rather than incidental.
Nurturing, correction, and completion supply the teacher's formative authority.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the transfer of knowledge that grounds the authorized relation.
The trimmed writing reed supplies the material instrument through which that teaching is mediated.

structural_cues: 96:1 and 96:3 repeat the same reading imperative, and 96:4-5 assign teaching to the Lord before the prohibiting figure appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reading, formative lordship, disclosure, and its writing instrument; I infer that these establish rightful instructional jurisdiction and that 96:19 rejects a competing jurisdiction. A live alternative is that the opening teaching scene and closing worship scene remain parallel rather than causally linked.

changed_reading.before: The verse transfers obedience away from an unnamed human.
changed_reading.after: The verse preserves the creator-teacher's channel of instruction by rejecting the censor's competing claim and approaching the source of teaching.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins as something attached, crosses the limit after imagining self-sufficiency, and remains on a path of return. Prostration and approach revise the baseline transfer of allegiance into restoration of acknowledged dependence.

activation_trace.role: Humble lowering supplies the bodily undoing of a self-sufficient posture.
Approach across distance turns dependence into directed movement rather than static abasement.
Attachment and clinging supply the human's initial condition of dependence.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the deformation produced by denied dependence.
Claimed self-sufficiency supplies the stated condition under which limit-crossing emerges.
Return to a prior point supplies the larger vector completed by the focus command to approach.

structural_cues: 96:2 begins the human account in attachment; 96:6-8 move from transgression through perceived self-sufficiency to return; 96:19 closes with lowering and approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, limit-crossing, self-sufficiency, and return; I infer a causal reversal in which prostration acknowledges dependence and approach enacts return. A live alternative is that these remain moral contrasts without an ontological restoration arc.

changed_reading.before: Refuse one allegiance and move nearer through worship.
changed_reading.after: Undo the fantasy of self-sufficiency by bodily reaccepting dependence and moving back toward its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: A figure restrains a servant at prayer, while the servant is tested as guided and as commanding protective conduct. The final negative and positive imperatives answer that conflict: refuse the restrainer's command and continue the very worship he attempts to stop.

activation_trace.role: Obedient yielding supplies the compliance demanded by the prohibiting figure and explicitly withheld from him.
Humble prostration supplies active persistence in the worship being obstructed.
Devotional approach supplies the positive end of resistance, preventing refusal from becoming mere defiance.
Restraint and blocking an act supply the coercive command answered in the focus.
Submissive worship identifies the blocked person's allegiance as devotional rather than servile to the blocker.
The specific worship act supplies the practice that the later prostration continues.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the servant's alternative orientation.
Command and obligation supply a second command relation that competes with the restrainer's demand.
Placing oneself in protection makes the servant's commanded conduct protective rather than merely oppositional.

structural_cues: 96:9-12 build two conditional tests around the singular figure who forbids a servant when he prays, and 96:19 addresses a singular object in تُطِعْهُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, servant-worship, prayer, guidance, command, and protection; I infer that the object pronoun in 96:19 returns to the prohibiting figure and that prostration deliberately resumes the blocked act. A live alternative is to hear the closing imperatives as a general devotional summary rather than public resistance.

changed_reading.before: Do not obey a wrongdoer; worship instead.
changed_reading.after: Publicly refuse the command that suppresses prayer, persist in the obstructed act, and direct that resistance toward devotional nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from a person seeing himself as self-sufficient, through repeated challenges to see, to denial and turning away, and finally to God's seeing. The lowered gaze of prostration reassigns which act of seeing governs the worshiper.

activation_trace.role: A steady lowered gaze supplies the focus posture that counters self-authorizing sight.
Nearness supplies the relational destination of the gaze shift.
Visual and inward seeing supplies the self-regarding perception that precedes claimed independence.
Contradiction of truth supplies the epistemic failure produced within the contested field of sight.
Turning away supplies the antagonist's bodily and relational response to truth.
The worshiped deity identifies whose sight closes the sequence and before whom prostration occurs.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the final governing witness under which the focus acts are performed.

structural_cues: 96:7 uses reflexive self-seeing, 96:9/11/13 repeat أَرَءَيْتَ, and 96:14 closes the sequence with ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ before the bodily command of 96:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sight, falsehood, turning away, deity, and a lowered-gaze branch; I infer a transfer from self-authorizing sight to action under divine witness. A live alternative is that seeing signifies knowledge and accountability without prescribing a gaze posture.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is a visible sign of submission.
changed_reading.after: Lower the self-authorizing gaze and approach while governed by the divine seeing that the denier ignores.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context contests control of body and assembly: a forelock can be seized, a man calls his council, the answering call brings agents of pushing and prevention, and the focus refuses pliancy before placing the forehead down voluntarily. Approach is thus self-directed movement after rival forces attempt to direct the person.

activation_trace.role: Yielding under a hand, rein, or lead supplies the control relation explicitly refused.
The forehead and prostrating limbs supply voluntary placement of the same bodily zone threatened with seizure.
Active approach supplies chosen direction after coerced direction is rejected.
Taking by the forelock supplies the threatened act of forced bodily control.
The forelock and seizure by it identify the head as the concrete control point.
Calling and inclining through speech supplies the antagonist's attempt to mobilize support.
The people's council and assembly supply the human collective summoned behind the prohibition.
The matching call supplies the answering mobilization and makes the two summons structurally rival.
Pushing, collision, and prevention supply the counterforce opposed to the human council.

structural_cues: 96:15-16 foreground the forelock, 96:17-18 mirror human and divine call verbs, and 96:19 immediately answers with negated obedience followed by two body-directed imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forelock-seizure, two calls, an assembly, pushing agents, and prostrating forehead limbs; I infer that the head becomes a contested interface and that voluntary prostration reverses coerced handling. A live alternative is a simpler sequence of threat followed by worship with no same-body reversal.

changed_reading.before: Refuse him, prostrate, and approach despite the threat.
changed_reading.after: Reclaim bodily direction from coercive hands and rival assemblies: place the threatened head down voluntarily, then move by command toward nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The courtly-access reading is surprising because the focus names no king or court; it remains anchored in ٱقْتَرِب's privileged-nearness branch and is activated by lordly sovereignty and the antagonist's council. Downstream prose should present it only as a political or institutional analogy, not as a lexical claim that the council is a royal court or that ٱقْتَرِب means appointment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱقْتَرِب at word 5 after the refusal to obey him.

activation_trace.role: Refused pliant obedience supplies the break with the local claimant's authority.
Favored access to a ruler's intimate circle supplies the counter-court image of nearness.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the higher authority to whom access is redirected.
The assembled council supplies the local institution whose mediation is bypassed.

changed_reading.before: Draw near devotionally after refusing the antagonist.
changed_reading.after: Bypass the antagonist's council and receive unmediated access to the higher Sovereign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because neck extension comes from the packet's non-dominant ط و ع to س ط ع mapping and is not the ordinary sense of تُطِعْ. It remains anchored through that supplied focus mapping and through the explicit head-lowering and forelock sequence. Downstream prose must label it a mapping-distant bodily echo, never a replacement translation for obedience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory for تُطِعْ at word 3 beside ٱسْجُدْ at word 4.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split image of an extended or raised neck supplies an exploratory upright body vector.
Bowing and lowering the head supply the immediate opposite body vector.
Approach supplies the destination reached after the vertical reversal.
Taking by the forelock activates the head and neck as the context's threatened control axis.
The forelock branch fixes that exploratory vertical contrast to a named head part in the context.

changed_reading.before: Do not obey him; lower yourself and approach.
changed_reading.after: As a contained bodily echo, abandon the extended-neck vector and choose voluntary head-lowering before another force directs the forelock.

strongest_changes: The focus became a transfer of jurisdiction: refusal protects allegiance to the creator-teacher rather than asserting commandless autonomy.
Attachment, false self-sufficiency, transgression, and return turned prostration into restoration of dependence.
The forelock threat and rival summons made voluntary forehead-lowering a reversal of coerced bodily and social direction.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activation joined grammar, body, and social force: the same closing sequence that threatens seizure of the forelock and mobilizes rival groups ends by refusing pliancy, voluntarily lowering the forehead, and approaching. The packet's split ط و ع mapping also exposed a tightly contained extended-neck counter-image.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination of prostration and approach may mark sequence rather than a causal means of access.
The gaze model may encode accountability without the stronger transfer-of-gaze mechanism.
The counter-court and non-dominant neck readings should remain analogical and exploratory.
